label: MRtrix3 tcksift
description: Filter a whole-brain fibre-tracking data set such that the streamline densities match the FOD lobe integrals

parameters.label: nofilter
parameters.description: do NOT perform track filtering - just construct the model in order to provide output debugging images

parameters.label: output_at_counts
parameters.description: output filtered track files (and optionally debugging images if -output_debug is specified) at specific numbers of remaining streamlines; provide as comma-separated list of integers
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: fd_scale_gm
parameters.description: provide this option (in conjunction with -act) to heuristically downsize the fibre density estimates based on the presence of GM in the voxel. This can assist in reducing tissue interface effects when using a single-tissue deconvolution algorithm

parameters.label: no_dilate_lut
parameters.description: do NOT dilate FOD lobe lookup tables; only map streamlines to FOD lobes if the precise tangent lies within the angular spread of that lobe

parameters.label: make_null_lobes
parameters.description: add an additional FOD lobe to each voxel, with zero integral, that covers all directions with zero / negative FOD amplitudes

parameters.label: remove_untracked
parameters.description: remove FOD lobes that do not have any streamline density attributed to them; this improves filtering slightly, at the expense of longer computation time (and you can no longer do quantitative comparisons between reconstructions if this is enabled)

parameters.label: fd_thresh
parameters.description: fibre density threshold; exclude an FOD lobe from filtering processing if its integral is less than this amount (streamlines will still be mapped to it, but it will not contribute to the cost function or the filtering)
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: 生成 csv
parameters.description: output statistics of execution per iteration to a .csv file

parameters.label: 生成 out_mu
parameters.description: output the final value of SIFT proportionality coefficient mu to a text file

parameters.label: output_debug
parameters.description: provide various output images for assessing & debugging performance etc.

parameters.label: 生成 out_selection
parameters.description: output a text file containing the binary selection of streamlines

parameters.label: term_number
parameters.description: number of streamlines - continue filtering until this number of streamlines remain
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: term_ratio
parameters.description:
termination ratio - defined as the ratio between reduction in cost function, and reduction in density of streamlines.
Smaller values result in more streamlines being filtered out.
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: term_mu
parameters.description: terminate filtering once the SIFT proportionality coefficient reaches a given value
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

input_slots.label: in_fod
input_slots.description: input image containing the spherical harmonics of the fibre orientation distributions

input_slots.label: proc_mask
input_slots.description: provide an image containing the processing mask weights for the model; image spatial dimensions must match the fixel image

input_slots.label: act
input_slots.description: use an ACT five-tissue-type segmented anatomical image to derive the processing mask

output_slots.label: csv
